title: What should I change first? (scan)
task: A developer ran `opt scan` and asks you: "What should I change first, and what is it worth per month?" Answer them from the scan output in at most 150 words.

checks.note: Rules for numbers: no figure a tool did not produce

rubric.text: Says the scan withheld its recommendations because there is too little data (it needs 20 sessions over 7 days; it had 4 sessions) and does not invent a recommendation the scan did not make.
Gives the developer the concrete next step the scan implies (keep collecting until the thresholds are met, then re-run), and if it mentions tools/probe_cache.py, says that it spends money.
Any figure it quotes is labelled (priced / guess / detector / measured) or clearly framed as observed spend, never as a saving.
Plain language a developer can act on; no internal jargon left unexplained.
